rejected.problem: `from: {type:'spell', maxRank:9}` does not match the printed restriction. The only formulation the engine can state honestly is to pick the OUTGOING spell via `own-spell` — a short, per-character, tradition-correct list — and state the same-rank replacement in `note` (the documented use of `note` for restrictions the app can't enforce, types.ts:606). skipped.reason: It only grants permission to re-edit a build choice that belongs to a different feat (Wayfinder Resonance Tinkerer); there is no separate per-day state to store beyond that feat's own cantrip selection.
The entire benefit lands on an ally (an ally rolls, an ally casts) rather than on the character's own sheet, and the target ally and GM-set DC are not enumerable in-app.
Designating a spell slot is part of the spell-slot preparation the app already models; it changes the slot table rather than storing a discrete named pick.
An unbounded 'any number' rebuild of evolution feat slots — that is a build edit the feat picker already owns, not one discrete answer worth storing as a daily flag.

The daily-preparations act is deliberately NOT choosing (leaving a gadget undeclared); the actual gadget is named later in play via an Interact action, so there is no answer at prep time, and gadget preparation itself is normal prep.
The thing chosen is a set of other party members, which the app has no roster to enumerate, and ally-targeted picks were deferred at the user's request.
No choice is made during daily preparations — the phrase only points at snares already prepared (normal snare prep), and the substitute snare is picked on the fly in play.

It only changes how the Esoteric Polymath pick carries over; the answer is a permanent repertoire swap (a spell you lose access to), which lives in the repertoire itself rather than as separate per-day state.
Swapping which surki heritage (and its evolution) you have is a build-level re-selection the builder already models, not a discrete per-day value stored alongside the build.
This feat only adds runes to the option list of Blessed Armament's existing daily rune choice; the stored pick belongs to that feature, and the runes named here are only part of the legal list.
The solid lead is designated during play when you give up a lead; daily preparations only offer a keep-or-clear of that existing designation, not a morning pick with an enumerable answer.
Swapping any number of duelist archetype feats is unbounded build retraining that the builder's feat selection already holds, with no single per-day answer to store.
Daily preparations only mark when the poison lock resets; the poison type is fixed by which save you rerolled in play, not chosen in the morning.
The recipients are allies rather than the character, and the feat only scales how many people an existing administer activity can reach; there is no enumerable thing the character stores for the day.

The patron-type choice is a permanent build decision made when the feat is taken, and the daily-preparations clause only cross-references Witch's Charge selection rather than asking for a new morning choice.
The thing chosen each day is an ally (a party member), not an enumerable game option the app can offer or resolve, and ally-target picks are out of scope.
The daily selection is a variable-sized set of other creatures to disguise, which is an ally/target choice with no enumerable answer for the character's own sheet.
The terrain is a one-off choice made when the feat is taken; daily preparations only let an expert in Survival re-pick it, so it belongs to the build (a feat choice), not to per-day state.

The pick designates a level-scaled roster of OTHER willing creatures whose benefits accrue to those creatures — the ally/NPC-designation shape the owner explicitly deferred in work/choice-lane/DECISIONS.md §3 — and a 'half your level' count can't be expressed as a fixed picks value.

It only widens the option list of the already-wired daily pick on runic-mind-smithing (flag `mindWeaponRune`) and adds a mid-day 10-minute swap, so a second picker would ask the same morning question twice; the correct fix is to extend runic-mind-smithing's options with the greater runes plus holy/unholy at 16th level.

It merely lets build decisions already stored on the character (innovation type, modifications, offensive boost) be changed daily and auto-repairs the innovation; there is no extra per-day answer to store.
This is free daily retraining of an impulse feat — the answer lives in the character's stored feat selections, so a separate daily flag would record a swap that never actually takes effect.

The app already models attunement as a build multi-pick (classes.animist.extraChoices 'apparition', pickByLevel {1:2,7:3,15:4}) plus build.primaryApparition, because the picks drive the apparition spell repertoire and Lore skills; a daily picker would be inert and duplicate it.
It only raises the number of apparitions chosen by Apparition Attunement (already handled by pickByLevel 7:3 in the animist extraChoices group); it adds no separate stored answer.
Same as Third Apparition — a count modifier on the existing Apparition Attunement build pick (pickByLevel 15:4), not a distinct daily choice.
The mutagen is picked at the moment the once-per-day ability is used, not during daily preparations; "since your last daily preparations" only bounds the eligible window.
